report_metadata.title: Batch_050 Verification Report
report_metadata.methodology: Direct bilibili API verification (api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/view) for all 16 available BV IDs. All API calls returned code:0 (success). Cross-referenced song title, P主, release date, and BV ID against API response. Files with date but no BV marked as partial. Files with neither BV nor date marked as unverifiable. Files that don't exist in filesystem marked as file_not_found.
